anomalies.observed: On the Microcontroller sheet, the thermocouple chip-select global labels are attached to the wrong ESP32-C3 GPIO pins: CS0 is on U1 pin 19 / GPIO3, CS1 is on U1 pin 20 / GPIO4, and CS2 is on U1 pin 22 / GPIO6. U1 pin 23 / GPIO7, which should carry CS2, has no CS label or connection.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the three thermocouple chip selects are driven by ESP32-C3 GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7: CS0 should be on GPIO4, CS1 on GPIO6, and CS2 on GPIO7.

evidence.quote: Sheet /Microcontroller/: U1 pin 19 GPIO3/ADC1_CH3 has label CS0; pin 20 GPIO4/ADC1_CH4 has label CS1; pin 22 GPIO6 has label CS2; pin 23 GPIO7 is unconnected.
three independent CS Output pins on GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7

anomalies.impact: Firmware that toggles GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 would select the wrong thermocouple channels: GPIO4 would assert CS1 (U3), GPIO6 would assert CS2 (U4), and GPIO7 would select nothing. U2/CS0 would never be selected, and the third zone would have no chip select.

parsed.summary: The schematic shows the thermocouple chip-select labels connected to GPIO3/GPIO4/GPIO6 instead of the specified GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7, leaving GPIO7 unconnected and shifting all zone selections.
